title: Late-year rebound scenario revenue-loss likelihood
limitations: Scenario alternatives are sensitivity cases, not assigned occurrence probabilities; the reported probability is the modeled probability of revenue loss conditional on that scenario holding, not the likelihood of the rebound itself.
Sensitivity alternatives do not define a calibrated credible interval.
The assessment is not causally identified and the bundle is inspection-only; recomputation is not supported.
Historical input provenance is incomplete for this assessment.
Risk is defined as neutral revenue minus event revenue; gains are retained in signed estimates, while tail measures apply to the positive shortfall.
Results cover all modeled countries jointly and are not a country-level or total-economy loss estimate, and are not a sovereign default probability.
